ffg.policy: official model-cycle RFC FFG; snapshot and encoded reference must both match the ensemble cycle; later publication is permitted

method.probability: peak of producer-style smoothed neighborhood probabilities
method.ffg_operator: neighborhood-maximum duration QPF compared with local matching-duration FFG, then Gaussian smoothing at each slot before the period maximum
method.ffg_combination: maximum across smoothed duration-specific probabilities and eligible times; no duration/time event union
method.ffg_cadence: 1h hourly; 3h/6h at forecast hours divisible by 3; entire accumulation inside selected window
method.spc_ffg_baseline: official RFC FFG for the exact synoptic ensemble cycle; publication after initialization is allowed
method.omd_ffg_baseline: native OMD official synoptic-cycle RFC FFG contract; same FFG cycle required for SPC
method.omd_processing: native producer neighborhood probabilities (generating process 194); no additional dilation
method.blend: 50% SPC suite maximum + 50% OMD suite maximum on identical native grids and valid periods; both required
method.spc_status: WPC experimental calculation using SPC member roster

ero_cam.source_completeness_contract: all ten SPC members, every selected hour, and every OMD probability slot required
